goal: Select public product sources and hand off custom tracking-link generation.
context: Public source URLs are not affiliate links. Generate custom links only in the logged-in portal; never scrape sessions or invent commission.
requirements: Keep campaigns blocked until custom links exist
acceptance_criteria: All source URLs are valid HTTPS URLs
Each source has a reason and campaign mapping
No credentials, tax data, commission or fake affiliate link stored
Custom tracking generation remains an explicit portal handoff
blockers: Custom affiliate tracking URLs must be generated in the authenticated Shopee/Lazada portal.
next_action: Use the logged-in affiliate portal to convert each exact product source into a tracking link and record product ID/commission shown by the portal.
